## Navigation.onBeforeNavButtonClick property

Callback invoked before navigation occurs when a nav button is clicked. Awaited before the route changes, so async cleanup is supported.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onBeforeNavButtonClick?: (detail: NavButtonClickDetail) => void | Promise<void>;
```

## Remarks

DOM events cannot be awaited, so this callback is the only way to guarantee execution before the route changes. The `nav-button-clicked` event fires after navigation and is suitable for informational use only.

## Example


```ts
<foundation-header
  :onBeforeNavButtonClick=${(x) => async (detail) => {
    await x.cleanup();
    console.log(`Navigating from ${detail.oldPath} to ${detail.newPath}`);
  }}
/>
```
